say:1:1721228001:1.text: Mind your words—and your hands. A captain of the guards and the esteemed Magister Merlin should know better than to accuse people lightly and drag them off without cause...
say:1:1721228001:1.source_cn: 话不能乱说，人不能乱抓。守备军的队长，和敬爱的大魔法师...
say:1:1721228001:1.male: Mind your words—and your hands. A captain of the guards and the esteemed Magister Merlin should know better than to accuse people lightly and drag them off without cause...
say:1:1721228001:1.female: Mind your words—and your hands. A captain of the guards and the esteemed Magister Merlin should know better than to accuse people lightly and drag them off without cause...

say:2:1721228002:1.text: If you insist on calling me a criminal, I do hope you've brought actual evidence to support these ridiculous charges.
say:2:1721228002:1.source_cn: 既然你们口口声声说我犯了罪，但愿你们真的找到了所谓的证...
say:2:1721228002:1.male: If you insist on calling me a criminal, I do hope you've brought actual evidence to support these ridiculous charges.
say:2:1721228002:1.female: If you insist on calling me a criminal, I do hope you've brought actual evidence to support these ridiculous charges.

say:3:1721228003:1.text: Because if you haven't, publicly disgracing a count will not reflect well on either of you.
say:3:1721228003:1.source_cn: 不然，当街对一位伯爵不敬，这可不是什么好事。

choice_prompt:4:1721228003.text: Because if you haven't, publicly disgracing a count will not reflect well on either of you.
choice_prompt:4:1721228003.source_cn: 不然，当街对一位伯爵不敬，这可不是什么好事。

narration:5:1721228004:1.text: Captain Fernand goes through your findings one by one.
narration:5:1721228004:1.male: Captain Fernand goes through your findings one by one.
narration:5:1721228004:1.female: Captain Fernand goes through your findings one by one.

narration:6:1721228005:1.text: Count Ramir's face darkens with every word. By the end, all he can manage is a bitter smile through clenched teeth...

say:7:1721228006:1.text: Well. I'll give you this—you have a knack for sniffing things out. That, and an irritating amount of luck.
say:7:1721228006:1.source_cn: 不得不说，你们很有当侦探的天赋和……运气。

say:8:1721228007:1.text: I didn't expect you to stumble into that enraged little creditor. And I certainly didn't expect the great Merlin to turn out to be a card shark. So fine. You got me.
say:8:1721228007:1.source_cn: 没想到你们竟然能碰上那个讨债鬼；而大魔法师梅林，居然还...
say:8:1721228007:1.male: I didn't expect you to stumble into that enraged little creditor. And I certainly didn't expect the great Merlin to turn out to be a card shark. So fine. You got me.
say:8:1721228007:1.female: I didn't expect you to stumble into that enraged little creditor. And I certainly didn't expect the great Merlin to turn out to be a card shark. So fine. You got me.

say:9:1721228008:1.text: Yes, I cheated Grandet. The man practically begged for it. Feed him a little lie, and he'll swallow it whole.
say:9:1721228008:1.source_cn: 我是骗了葛朗台。谁叫他那么蠢，随便糊弄几句就真信了？

say:10:1721228009:1.text: He probably thought he was one miracle away from saving the king and being thanked with a title of his own. Ha! Honestly, just imagining that puffed-up idiot basking in his future glory is enough to make me laugh all over again!
say:10:1721228009:1.source_cn: 估计他现在还觉得那是什么“霓光鲤”，等着救活国王，被陛...

say:12:1721228010:1.text: So that's it? You tricked Baron Grandet into believing the neon carp could cure any illness—all for money, and nothing more?
say:12:1721228010:1.source_cn: 你只是为了求财，才诈骗葛朗台男爵，哄骗他那是能治百病的...

say:13:1721228011:1.text: Of course. What else would it be?

choice_prompt:14:1721228011.text: Of course. What else would it be?

say:16:1721228013:1.text: Remarkable. You're skilled at magic, excellent at cards, and apparently blessed with a very vivid imagination as well.
say:16:1721228013:1.source_cn: 看来阁下不仅魔法能力高超、牌技好，想象力也很丰富。
say:16:1721228013:1.male: Remarkable. You're skilled at magic, excellent at cards, and apparently blessed with a very vivid imagination as well.
say:16:1721228013:1.female: Remarkable. You're skilled at magic, excellent at cards, and apparently blessed with a very vivid imagination as well.

say:17:1721228014:1.text: I just wanted more money to spend at the tables. Honestly, looking back, I almost regret not pushing him harder.
say:17:1721228014:1.source_cn: 我就只是为了多赚点钱来打牌而已。现在想想，我还觉得可惜呢。

say:18:1721228015:1.text: One million gold was clearly far below what Baron Grandet was willing to pay for a chance to impress the king. If I'd known how desperate he was, I could've squeezed quite a bit more out of him.
say:18:1721228015:1.source_cn: 一百万哪里抵得上葛朗台男爵对陛下这一片忠心？早知道，就...

say:19:1721228016:1.text: Count Ramir, with this many charges stacked against you, I doubt you'll have much use for money where you're going.
say:19:1721228016:1.source_cn: 拉米尔伯爵，数罪并罚之下，恐怕你再也用不上这些钱了。

say:20:1721228017:1.text: Makes no difference to me. The million is gone, and I had a wonderful time spending it.
say:20:1721228017:1.source_cn: 无所谓，反正一百万我已经花光了。享受过了就行。

choice:14:0:1.text: I doubt it was that simple.
choice:14:0:1.male: I doubt it was that simple.
choice:14:0:1.female: I doubt it was that simple.

choice:14:1:2.text: You implied to him that the fish could save the king.
choice:14:1:2.source_cn: 是你暗示葛朗台这鱼能救国王
choice:14:1:2.male: You implied to him that the fish could save the king.
choice:14:1:2.female: You implied to him that the fish could save the king.

choice:14:2:3.text: You encouraged him to turn it into a public spectacle.
choice:14:2:3.source_cn: 你暗示他借这件事大肆炒作？
choice:14:2:3.male: You encouraged him to turn it into a public spectacle.
choice:14:2:3.female: You encouraged him to turn it into a public spectacle.

choice:4:1:2.text: Captain, tell him what we found!
choice:4:1:2.source_cn: 队长，把我们的调查结果告诉他！
choice:4:1:2.male: Captain, tell him what we found!
choice:4:1:2.female: Captain, tell him what we found!
